description: Full conic-sections drill set across three sub-lessons: parabola (identify vertex/focus/directrix from standard or shifted form, convert general-form equation to standard form, build equation from vertex+focus or focus+directrix, find point on parabola at given distance from focus/directrix, tangent-line slope property, BAC-exam bank), ellipse (identify a,b,c/vertices/foci from standard or shifted form, convert general form to standard, build equation from given vertices/foci/eccentricity/point-on-ellipse conditions), and hyperbola (identify a,b,c/vertices/foci/asymptotes from standard or shifted form, convert general form to standard, build equation from vertices/foci/asymptote-slope/point conditions).

source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 math exercise compendium (Start Up Community), Lesson 13: កោនិក (Conics) — Parabola/Ellipse/Hyperbola sub-lessons — exercises only, no worked solutions
source.extracted_by: manual OCR/transcription from scanned textbook (Claude Code), 2026-08-29

exercises.technique: Read (h,k) vertex and p from the standard shifted-parabola form (y-k)^2=4p(x-h) or (x-h)^2=4p(y-k); focus is p away from vertex along the axis, directrix is the line p on the other side
Complete the square to reduce the general conic equation to standard vertex form

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Build parabola equation given vertex and focus/directrix, for 18 vertex-parameter pairs: }V(0,0),F(2,0);\ V(3,2),F(1,2);\ V(-2,3),F(-2,4);\ V(-3,1),F(0,1);\ V(0,3),F(-1,3);\ V(0,0),F(0,2);\ V(0,-4),\text{directrix}\ y=2;\ V(-2,1),\text{directrix}\ x=1;\ V(2,2),\text{directrix}\ y=-3;\ V(-3,1),\text{directrix}\ x=1;\ V(0,1),\text{directrix}\ x+1=0;\ V(-2,2),\text{directrix}\ 4-x=0;\ V(3,4),\text{directrix}\ 2y-4=0;\ V(1,3),\text{directrix}\ 2+2y=0;\ \text{focus}\ F(2,1),\text{directrix}\ x=-2;\ \text{focus}\ F(-3,4),\text{directrix}\ y=2;\ \text{focus}\ F(-3,-2),\text{directrix}\ x-1=0;\ \text{focus}\ F(-2,0),\text{directrix}\ 2+y=0;\ \text{focus}\ F(-1,2),\text{directrix}\ \tfrac12x=1;\ \text{focus}\ F(-4,2),\text{directrix}\ 2y+2=0
exercises.technique: Build a parabola's equation from vertex+focus (finds axis direction and p directly), or focus+directrix (vertex is the midpoint, p is half the distance)

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Build parabola through given points with described symmetry (5 items), e.g. symmetric about }(x'ox)\text{ passing through }(3,2)\text{ with vertex }(1,1);\ \text{decide if}\ x^2+x-4y+49/4=0\ \text{is a parabola;}\ \text{(BAC 2019) }y^2+4y-8x-12=0\text{: prove parabola, find vertex/focus/directrix;}\ \text{(BAC 2004) find }S,F\text{ for }x^2-4x-12y+16=0
exercises.technique: Word-style parabola construction from geometric description, plus verifying general-form equations are indeed parabolas and extracting their features (curated BAC exam problems)

exercises.prompt_latex: (P):2y^2+8y+3x-4=0:\ \text{find vertex/focus/directrix; find intersection with}\ x=-2;\ \text{sketch};\ (P):y^2-4y-8x+12=0:\ \text{find vertex, general eq., directrix; intersection with}\ x=3;\ (P)\ \text{with vertex}\ V(3,-5),\ \text{axis through}\ A(5,3):\ \text{find standard equation};\ (P):x^2-2x-2y+4=0:\ \text{find }V,F,\text{directrix; intersection with}\ (xoy);\ (P):\tfrac14y^2-y+x+1=0:\ \text{check standard form, find}\ V,F,\text{directrix, sketch};\ (P)\ \text{with vertex}\ (0,0),\ \text{focus on}\ (x'ox):\ \text{find eq. through}\ A_1(-2,4);\ \text{find}\ y_2\ \text{for}\ A_2(-3,y_2)\ \text{on}\ (P);\ \text{find directrix}\ (\Delta)$
exercises.technique: Multi-part parabola full-analysis problems combining conversion, feature extraction, intersection-with-line, and sketching

exercises.prompt_latex: (P):(x-a)^2=4(y-b),\ F(2,1)\ \text{given: find}\ a,b;\ \text{curve}\ (C):y^2-6x^2+4y+19=0\ \text{(hyperbola sanity-check)}:\ \text{verify}\ A(2,1)\text{ on }(C),\ \text{find}\ y'\ \text{as function of}\ x,y,\ \text{tangent line at}\ A;\ (P):y^2=16x:\ \text{tangent line parallel to}\ 3x-2y+6=0;\ \text{tangent through}\ M(-1,0);\ (P):y^2=8x:\ \text{tangent perpendicular to}\ 2x+2y-3=0;\ (P):y^2=64x:\ \text{find point}\ M\ \text{with tangent parallel to}\ 4x+3y=-48;\ \text{focus}\ F(3,0)\text{, directrix}\ 3x-4y+16=0:\ \text{find distance from}\ F\ \text{to directrix; find parabola eq. with vertex at }O;\ (P):y^2=4x:\ \text{find focus, directrix, sketch; line through}\ A(4,4)\ \text{perpendicular to axis; area of triangle formed}
exercises.technique: Geometric word problems requiring the tangent-slope property of a parabola (slope at (x_1,y_1) is 2p/y_1) and focus-directrix distance relationships

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Line through }A(2,5),B(-2,-3),C(1,6)\text{: find parabola with these on it (curve-fit-like)};\ \text{similarly for}\ A(-1,1),B(11,-2),C(5,-1);\ \text{find equation of parabola}\ y^2=2x\text{'s tangent line at point}\ (-4,1);\ \text{point}\ P\ \text{equidistant from}\ F(-1,2)\ \text{and line}\ y=6\text{: find locus};\ \text{find}\ m,b\ \text{s.t. line}\ y=mx+b\ \text{tangent to}\ y^2=4px\ \text{at a point implies}\ p=mb;\ \text{prove tangent line to}\ y^2=4px\ \text{at}\ P(x_1,y_1)\ \text{has slope}\ y_1/(2x_1)\ [\text{sic, printed as }2p/y_1];\ \text{find locus of}\ M(x,y)\ \text{equidistant from}\ A(3,1)\ \text{and line}\ x=1;\ \text{given}\ A,B\in(P):y=x^2\ \text{with}\ AB=2,\ \text{find midpoint locus as A,B slide}
exercises.technique: Locus/definition-based parabola problems (equidistant from focus and directrix), tangent-line general-form proofs, and midpoint-locus problems
Read a,b,c (with c^2=a^2-b^2 for a>b) directly from standard/shifted ellipse form, or complete the square / expand a disguised product-form equation first

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Build ellipse standard equation given: foci }(5,0),(-5,0),c=2;\ \text{center}(0,0),\text{vertex}(0,4),b=1;\ I(0,0),\text{focus}(-1,0),\text{vertex}(3,0);\ (0,0),\text{focus}(2,0),\text{vertex}(3,0);\ I(0,0),\text{focus}(0,1),\text{vertex}(0,-2);\ \text{foci}(0,-4)\&\text{vertices}(0,\pm8);\ \text{foci}(0,3)\&(0,-3),\ (x'x)\text{ crosses at}\pm2;\ \text{foci}(1,1)\&(1,9),\text{major axis length}10;\ \text{center}(0,2),\text{focus}(0,0),\text{minor axis length}4;\ \text{center}(4,2),\text{focus}(1,2),\text{major axis length}10;\ \text{center}(0,0),\text{focus}(2,0),\text{minor axis length}6;\ \text{foci}(0,-2)\&(0,2),\text{major axis length}8;\ \text{through given points}(1,1)(5,1)\text{with foci}(3,0)(3,2)};\ \text{focus}(2,0)\&(-2,0),\ e=3/5;\ \text{focus}(0,0)\&\text{minor-axis-vertices}(3,1)(4,0);\ \text{focus}(0,0)\&\text{vertices}(0,\pm6)\text{through}(3,2);\ \text{focus}(0,0)\&\text{through}(2,3)(6,1);\ \text{focus}(0,0)\&\text{minor-axis-vertices, focal chord}=8\text{through}(3,0);\ \text{minor-axis-vertices}(3,0)(-3,0)\&\text{focal chord}(-2,0)(2,0);\ \text{minor-axis vertex}(0,-1)\&\text{focal chord}(0,-3)(0,3);\ \text{focal chord}(0,-2)(0,2)\&\text{focal-chord-length}8\text{through}(3,0);\ \text{major-axis-vertices}(4,0)(-4,0)\&\text{through}(3,0)
exercises.technique: Build ellipse standard equation from various geometric parameter combinations (foci+vertex, center+eccentricity, focal chord, semi-latus-rectum, or a point lying on the ellipse)

exercises.prompt_latex: 9x^2+5y^2-45=0:\ \text{find semi-axes, vertices, foci};\ (E):4x^2+9y^2-8x+36y+4=0:\ \text{find center/vertices/foci; find intersection with axis; sketch, given}\ 4\sqrt2/3=1.9;\ (E)\ \text{with}\ A(1,-2),\ F_1(1-\sqrt5,-2),F_2(1+\sqrt5,-2),\ \text{major axis}=6:\ \text{find standard eq., vertices};\ (E):25x^2+9y^2-18y=216:\ \text{find standard eq., features};\ (E):12x^2+20y^2-12x+40y-37=0:\ \text{find asymptote-axis center/vertex/focus; intersections with axes; sketch};\ (E):x^2+4y^2-2x+16y+13=0:\ \text{find center, focus, vertex; intersection with}\ (y'oy);\ (E):25x^2+12y^2=300:\ \text{find center, focus, vertex; intersections; sketch};\ \text{find ellipse eq. with vertices}(0,0)(4,0)\text{and points on ellipse summing distance }10\text{ to foci};\ \text{tangent line to}\ 4x^2+y^2=4\ \text{through}(3,0);\ \text{find ellipse eq. with center}(0,0),\ \text{minor-axis vertices}(\pm2,0),\ \text{foci}(0,\pm1/3)$
exercises.technique: Full ellipse-feature multi-part problems: general-to-standard conversion, extract center/vertices/foci, find axis intersections, and sketch
Read a,b,c (with c^2=a^2+b^2) and asymptote slopes \pm b/a (or \pm a/b depending on orientation) from standard/shifted hyperbola form, or complete the square first

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Identify hyperbola from disguised product form: }(3x-2y)(3x+2y)=1\cdot36\ [\tfrac{(3x-2y)}6\cdot\tfrac{(3x+2y)}6=1];\ \left(\tfrac{4x-5y}{20}\right)\left(\tfrac{4x+5y}{20}\right)+1=0;\ (4x+3y)(4x-3y)=144;\ (2x+y)^2=4(xy+1)+2y^2;\ \text{build hyperbola standard equation given: center}(0,0),\text{vertex}(3,0),\text{through}(1,0);\ \text{center}(0,0),\text{focus}(0,5),\text{through}(0,3);\ \text{center}(0,0),\text{focus}(-3,0),\text{through}(2,0);\ \text{vertices}(0,\pm3)\&\text{foci}(0,\pm5);\ \text{vertices}(\pm3,0)\&\text{foci}(\pm5,0);\ \text{foci}(-5,0)(5,0)\&\text{vertices}(3,0)\text{(implied pair)};\ \text{foci}(0,6)\&\text{vertices}(0,\pm2);\ \text{foci}(-4,0)(4,0),\text{asymptote}\ y=2x;\ \text{vertices}(\pm1,0),\text{asymptotes}\ y=\pm3x;\ \text{vertices}(0,\pm3),\text{asymptotes}\ y=\pm3x;\ \text{vertices}(2,\pm3)\&\text{a focal chord through}(0,5);\ \text{foci}(6,1)(-2,1),\text{asymptotes}\ y=\tfrac34x-\tfrac12,y=-\tfrac34x+\tfrac52
exercises.technique: Recognize a hyperbola disguised as a difference-of-squares product, and build standard equations from vertex/focus/asymptote-slope combinations

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Build hyperbola from foci}(-3,0)(3,0),\text{asymptotes}\ y=\pm\tfrac34x;\ \text{focus}(-2,0)(2,0),\ y=-x;\ \text{foci}(0,0)\&(8,0),\ \text{a focal-radius pair through}(3,0);\ \text{center}(0,-1),\text{focus}(0,-3)(0,3);\ \text{given equation}\ 9y^2-16x^2=144,\ \text{prove hyperbola, find vertices/foci, find asymptote equations}
exercises.technique: Continued build-from-conditions problems and a final hard-level verify-and-extract-features item

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Identify vertex, focus, directrix for 8 parabola equations (mix of standard and disguised forms like}\ (x+2)(x-2)-4y=0,(x+y)^2=x(2y-4+x));\ \text{find standard eq. and directrix given vertex+focus, for 10 vertex-focus/directrix pairs};\ (P):y^2-4y-8x+12=0:\ \text{find vertex, focus, directrix, sketch, intersection with}\ x=3;\ (P):x^2-2x-2y+4=0:\ \text{find}\ V,F,(D);\ \text{match 8 ellipse equations to their vertices/foci (semi-axes given as }a=5,b=4\text{ etc.)};\ \text{identify vertex/focus pairs and standard equation from 8 disguised general-form ellipse equations (incl. }(2x-y)^2+4xy=4\text{-style)};\ \text{5 word-built ellipse equations from vertex+focus / focus+focal-chord conditions};\ \text{match 8 hyperbola equations (mix of standard and disguised product-form) to vertices/foci/asymptotes};\ \text{5 word-built hyperbola equations from vertex+focus / vertex+eccentricity conditions}
exercises.technique: Semester-2 review bank (section VI, final): matching-style review across all three conics — given a general or disguised equation, identify type and features; given features, build the equation — closing out the book
